history.subject: Sponsorship & Stall Opportunity: Fergusson Fest 2026 x Chai Junction
history.body: Hi Chai Junction team, We are organizing Fergusson Fest 2026 on December 12th, bringing together over 1,800 students from Fergusson College. With your cafe located just 300 meters away on FC Road, Chai Junction is already a natural go-to spot for our campus community. We would love to partner with you to give your team direct visibility among students and local hostel residents through dedicated stall space, voucher distributions, and digital promotions. I have attached our sponsorship deck detailing flexible partnership packages starting from INR 8,000. Would you be open to a quick 5-minute chat this week to explore this? Warm regards, Outreach Team, Fergusson Fest 2026
